source.origin: Verilog twin of ofdm32_demod_1r1w: upstream logikbench RX (as in ofdm32_demod_upstream, same RTLScout-marked edits) behind a 1R/1W wrapper FSM
source.design: flexible-schedule OFDM receiver (CP discard -> FFT -> rescale -> QAM demap) behind a 1r1w memory port; TB_CYCLES/TB_READS/TB_WRITES scored
source.oracle: harness content-checks the 12 recovered-bit words against goldens captured from the upstream RTL's RX fed the TX tap stream through a seeded noisy channel (uniform +-64 LSB, verified below the decision threshold); samples-in/bits-out, so no copy shortcut exists; no CEC
